memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma, bilateral.
Patient reports mild bilateral eye discomfort, worse in the morning, no visual loss. On examination, conjunctivae are quiet, corneas clear, anterior chambers deep. Intraocular pressure measured by applanation tonometry: right 22 mmHg, left 24 mmHg. Optic discs show mild cupping (vertical cup-to-disc ratio 0.4). Visual fields pending. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops – one drop in each eye twice daily
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops – one drop in each eye at bedtime

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Intraocular pressure (IOP): Right eye 22 mmHg (reference 10-21), Left eye 24 mmHg (reference 10-21).
Central corneal thickness: Right 540 µm, Left 545 µm.
No acute changes noted.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been using the drops as prescribed. My eyes feel a bit gritty in the mornings but improve after a few minutes. No redness or pain.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma, bilateral, stable.
Patient denies worsening eye discomfort; reports occasional morning gritty sensation that resolves with blinking. Examination: IOP right 20 mmHg, left 22 mmHg. Corneas clear, chambers deep. Optic discs unchanged (cup-to-disc ratio 0.4 each). No new visual field defects noted on confrontation. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
timolol 0.5% eye drops – one drop in each eye twice daily
latanoprost 0.005% eye drops – one drop in each eye at bedtime
brimonidine tartrate 0.1% eye drops – one drop in each eye three times daily (added for IOP control)

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Intraocular pressure after 3 months: Right eye 18 mmHg (reference 10-21), Left eye 19 mmHg (reference 10-21).
Brimonidine allergy screen: negative.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma, bilateral, mild progression suspected.
Patient notes increased difficulty reading fine print, especially in low light. No pain. Examination: IOP right 21 mmHg, left 23 mmHg. Optic discs show slight increase in cupping (vertical cup-to-disc ratio 0.45 OD, 0.47 OS). Conjunctivae quiet. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Optic disc assessment via stereoscopic fundus photography: Right disc vertical cup-to-disc ratio 0.45, left 0.47. Rim thinning noted inferotemporally both eyes. No disc haemorrhages. Retinal nerve fibre layer analysis suggestive of early glaucomatous change.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Dr. Lavanya Natarajan, Glaucoma Specialist, Narayana Nethralaya, Bengaluru. Reason: Suspected glaucomatous progression despite maximal topical therapy; need for possible surgical intervention or adjunctive therapy. Please assess IOP, visual fields, and consider laser trabeculoplasty or filtering surgery.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral outcome: Specialist reviewed case. IOP remains borderline high; visual fields show early paracentral scotoma OD. Recommended selective laser trabeculoplasty (SLT) in both eyes, continue current meds, and schedule follow-up in 8 weeks. No immediate surgery needed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma, bilateral, post‑SLT, stable.
Patient reports no new visual symptoms; occasional morning gritty feeling unchanged. Examination: IOP right 16 mmHg, left 17 mmHg. Optic discs unchanged from previous photography (cup-to-disc ratio 0.45 OD, 0.47 OS). Conjunctivae quiet. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Visual field testing (Humphrey 24-2): Mean deviation -0.8 dB OD, -0.6 dB OS (within age‑adjusted normal limits). Pattern standard deviation normal. No clinically significant defect detected.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for glaucoma review with Dr Suresh Menon on 2026-07-15 at 10:30 AM. Patient reminded to bring eye drop bottles and continue current therapy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Primary open-angle glaucoma, bilateral, well controlled.
Patient asymptomatic; denies ocular discomfort. Examination: IOP right 15 mmHg, left 16 mmHg. Optic discs stable (cup-to-disc ratio 0.45 OD, 0.47 OS). Visual field testing within normal limits. Smoking status: never smoker, pack-years 0.
